paragraphs: Travel CRM for multiple companies, with a React/TypeScript frontend, a Node/Fastify API, and Supabase Auth, Postgres, and Storage. The old ERP is a read-only reference; this repository does not connect to or alter it.

The interface follows the supplied dashboard reference with the #FDF2FB, #4A3A52, #C084FC, and #A5D8FF palette and self-hosted Spectral/Karla fonts. The shared design layer is in apps/web/src/theme.css. Each company can set its document logo and accent color independently.
features: Full-width company workspaces, invite-only sign-in, staff, configurable roles, company settings, private files, and activity records.

TravCRM owner portal with reusable plans, pricing, trials, enforced feature and usage limits, MRR and company health, subscription controls, time-limited audited support access, suspension, archiving, restoration, and…
Queries, follow-ups, lead sources, clients, day plans, hotels, houseboats, room types, cabs, and supporting catalogs.
Numbered quotation revisions with rooming, assignee, structured INR/GST price lines, day plans, stays, optional daily transport, branded PDF, and outbound email/WhatsApp sending.
Explicit quotation confirmation into a controlled booking snapshot, supplier stay tracking, daily transport operations, revision history, and editable draft or locked issued stay/cab vouchers.
